title: Escena de Fiesta de Chicas Estilo Anime
prompt:
Add multiple anime-style girls with different personalities to the room.
This is an extremely lively and joyful 8-person girls' party scene:
Pink twin-tailed girl: Wearing a white cute nightgown with lace trim, kneeling in the center of the bed, holding a down pillow high, about to playfully hit her friend opposite, with an excited and mischievous expression.
Golden long curly-haired girl: Wearing silk-textured blue camisole pajamas, leaning back on the other side of the bed, holding another pillow with both hands for defense, her face showing an amused laugh.
Purple short-haired girl: Wearing a loose printed oversized T-shirt, curled up in a corner at the foot of the bed, wearing a cute panda eye mask and sound asleep, completely ignoring the surrounding noise, seemingly with sleep bubbles coming from her nose.
Silver cat-ear hairstyle girl: Wearing an orange hooded sweatshirt and shorts, sitting cross-legged on the wooden floor in the center below the bed, fully focused on the game controller in her hands, with a tense and serious expression.
Red short-haired girl: Wearing a sports tank top and hot pants, lying on the back of the silver-haired gaming girl, one hand around her neck, the other pointing at the game screen excitedly shouting commands.
Chestnut-colored braided girl: Wearing a beige knit cardigan and long skirt, elegantly sitting on a lazy sofa or chair by the window, holding a book and hot tea, looking up gently at the playing friends.
Blue long straight-haired girl: Wearing fashionable off-shoulder loungewear, occupying the left foreground (Close-up), holding up her phone with one hand, making a "peace sign" selfie at the camera, trying to capture the entire scene behind her, one eye winking.
Green bun-haired girl: Wearing an apron with ruffles, walking in from the right edge of the scene, hands holding a full tray of happy drinks and snacks, seeing the messy scene showing a helpless yet doting wry smile.
